pattern-selector.why: the forces are one ordering rule for three append-only files, run by git as an external process; the fit is a single committed driver script with no abstraction (deliberately no pattern). Rejected: keeping union and relaxing the checkers to a set check, which would weaken the append-only proof.
pattern-selector.what: wrote one CLI driver with a merge() function and an --install mode; recorded the options and the rejected ones in ADR-0107.
quotes: the structure that fits the forces this system will actually face, chosen on purpose

architectural-decision-records.why: replacing the union driver for the logs changes a decision ADR-0087 recorded; a future maintainer will ask why the logs need a custom driver and why it is registered from prepare.
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR-0107 (root cause, options, rules, transition step, limits) and set ADR-0087's status to superseded for the logs; check_adr.sh passes on both.
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: as in the ADR-0087 change, the merge behavior is enumerated by case in the .mjs scenario test (the coupling rule treats a changed .mjs as a behavior surface); happy, adverse, boundary, and error cases for the contributor audience are covered.
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: 22 scenarios in real temp repos: merge both ways, rebase, cherry-pick, stash, markdown, duplicates, substring, history edit, far deletion, stale origin/HEAD, unregistered driver, installer scopes, the shadowed-union root cause.
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment.

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: the defect only shows up in a real git merge (driver selection, config shadowing, ordering), so the tests run real git in throwaway repos with the real --install command, not a unit test of the string logic alone.
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: extended test/union-merge.test.mjs with ~21,000-character lines and every merge mode; updated the prepare assertion in test/self-dogfood-prepush.test.mjs.
quotes: Test at the lowest level that can catch the bug

verifiable-quality-gates.why: the driver protects the inputs of three append-only gates, and its tests must fail when any rule is neutralized.
verifiable-quality-gates.what: mutation run: 11 driver mutants (order, dedupe, markers, replay, upstream order, installer hint, markdown exemption) each fail a named test; baseline passes.
quotes: test must FAIL when the check is replaced by a no-op

skeptical-audit.why: the root cause was a claim to prove, not assume: line length, hunk alignment, and ort were ruled out by running merge-file on the real blobs, and the config was proven causal by the same merge with and without it.
skeptical-audit.what: recorded the reproduction and the ruled-out causes in ADR-0107, with limits (Windows-only runs, GitHub behavior not assessed, msys sh launch failures).
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it

judge-arch.why: the change adds a script that git runs on every log merge, so it got fresh-context review over every changed file.
judge-arch.what: three fresh-context passes with temp-repo probes found 12 issues; 10 fixed, 2 documented as limits; review entry appended and check-arch-review-coverage passes with --base.
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all of them.

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: the simplest thing that meets the real requirement (no lost line, main's log a prefix) is one script plus one attribute line, not a log service or a rewrite of the checkers.
enterprise-architecture-standards.what: kept the driver to one file, kept CHANGELOG.md on union, kept install-hooks.mjs unchanged.
quotes: Simplicity that meets the real requirement is a core principle, not a shortcut.

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: the review log and receipt log are this repo's audit trail; a merge that silently dropped entries broke their append-only, tamper-evident property.
compliance-data-lifecycle.what: the driver refuses any side that edits or removes a past entry (whole-file conflict markers) and keeps every appended entry with the upstream log as an exact prefix.
quotes: Audit logs must be tamper-evident (for example a hash chain), retained per

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: no untrusted input, auth, secret, or network surface: the driver reads git's temp files and the repo's own refs, and spawns git with argument arrays (no shell string built from file content).

release-deployment-safety.why: no deploy, migration, flag, or service rollout; the change reaches a clone through npm install. The one transition step for already-open branches is documented in ADR-0107 and the changelog.

sre-operational-readiness.why: no running service, endpoint, SLO, or alert; a local git merge driver covered by tests.

arch-encode.why: the caught mistake is a machine-local git config entry, not a source pattern arch-gate can grep; it is pinned instead by the installer warning and the ROOT CAUSE and --install tests.

universal-browser-device-support.why: no browser or device surface; a Node CLI run by git.

usability-ux-universal-design.why: no end-user UI; the driver's stderr messages name the file, the reason, and the fix in plain words.
